package.name: ShortCuts
package.description: Manage, visualise and learn FreeCAD keyboard shortcuts. ShortCuts adds a searchable list of commands with their shortcuts per workbench, a keyboard view that shows the shortcuts laid out on the physical keyboard (with a modifier overlay for Ctrl/Shift/Alt layers), drag-and-drop assignment of shortcuts directly on the keyboard, and a printable cheat sheet. It also keeps the original Shift+Q command overlay.
package.author: triplus
